\section*{Chapter 7 - VIF (Vision-Influence Factor)}


\subsection*{Purpose}
\item Define the Vision-Influence Factor (VIF) as the confidence signal that keeps work aligned with the north star.
\item Describe how VIF is calculated, interpreted, trended, and acted on across teams.
\item Provide runnable snippets that read and update confidence so reviewers can verify the live signal.

\subsection*{What VIF Measures}
VIF answers two questions simultaneously:
1. \textbf{How strongly does this effort advance the vision?} (vision alignment)
2. \textbf{How confident are we that the intended outcome will land?} (influence confidence)

The signal is expressed on a 0-1 scale. Tier thresholds:
\item Tier S systems (CMC, HHNI): VIF >= 0.95
\item Tier A systems (VIF, APOE, SEG, Integration): VIF >= 0.90
\item Tier B systems: VIF >= 0.85

\subsection*{Inputs and Normalization}
Primary inputs (each normalized to z-scores):
\item \texttt{vision\_alignment}: derived from roadmap linkage and leadership review.
\item \texttt{outcome\_impact}: sized impact (people unblocked, critical path acceleration).
\item \texttt{recency\_stability}: freshness of supporting evidence and absence of regressions.
\item \texttt{authority\_alignment}: Tier A source agreement; penalizes conflicting anchors.

Combined signal:
``\texttt{
vif = w1 \textit{ vision\_alignment + w2 } outcome\_impact
    + w3 \textit{ recency\_stability + w4 } authority\_alignment
}`\texttt{
Weights default to }{0.35, 0.30, 0.20, 0.15}\texttt{ and are reviewed weekly.

\subsection*{Dashboards and Telemetry}
\item \textbf{Trend dashboard:} VIF over time per chapter/system, highlighting drops >0.03.
\item \textbf{Heatmap:} Current VIF vs threshold by tier (critical items bubble to top).
\item \textbf{Regression feed:} Most negative delta (24h / 7d) with links to evidence or gaps.

\subsection*{Operational Use}
\item \textbf{Gating:} Work cannot proceed if VIF < tier threshold; requires remediation plan.
\item \textbf{Triage:} Sort backlog by }VIF * Impact\texttt{ to focus on high-leverage tasks.
\item \textbf{Review:} Weekly review includes a "VIF check-in" where each owner explains deltas.
\item \textbf{Escalation:} Two consecutive drops trigger a mandatory deep-dive (root cause + mitigation stored in CMC).

\subsection*{System Architecture}

VIF consists of four core components that work together to provide verifiable intelligence:

\subsubsection*{1. Witness Generator}
\textbf{Purpose:} Create cryptographic witness envelopes for all AI operations

\textbf{Responsibilities:}
\item Capture complete provenance (model ID, weights hash, prompt template, tools used, writer)
\item Generate confidence scores and bands (A/B/C)
\item Create deterministic witness envelopes
\item Store witnesses in CMC for auditability

\textbf{Key Operations:}
\item }create\_witness()\texttt{ - Generate witness envelope for operation
\item }attach\_witness()\texttt{ - Link witness to atom/operation
\item }verify\_witness()\texttt{ - Validate witness integrity
\item }get\_provenance()\texttt{ - Retrieve full provenance chain

\subsubsection*{2. κ-Gating Module}
\textbf{Purpose:} Enforce confidence thresholds to prevent low-confidence responses

\textbf{Responsibilities:}
\item Check confidence against tier thresholds (Tier S: 0.95, Tier A: 0.90, Tier B: 0.85)
\item Enforce abstention when confidence < 0.70
\item Route low-confidence work to research or human review
\item Track confidence deltas and trends

\textbf{Key Operations:}
\item }check\_confidence()\texttt{ - Validate confidence meets threshold
\item }should\_abstain()\texttt{ - Determine if operation should abstain
\item }route\_to\_research()\texttt{ - Route low-confidence work to ARD
\item }escalate\_to\_human()\texttt{ - Request human review

\subsubsection*{3. Confidence Calibrator}
\textbf{Purpose:} Calibrate confidence scores for accuracy

\textbf{Responsibilities:}
\item Extract confidence from LLM outputs
\item Calibrate scores using historical accuracy
\item Assign confidence bands (A/B/C)
\item Track calibration accuracy over time

\textbf{Key Operations:}
\item }extract\_confidence()\texttt{ - Extract confidence from LLM output
\item }calibrate\_score()\texttt{ - Adjust confidence using calibration data
\item }assign\_band()\texttt{ - Assign confidence band (A/B/C)
\item }update\_calibration()\texttt{ - Learn from outcomes

\subsubsection*{4. Provenance Tracker}
\textbf{Purpose:} Maintain complete audit trail for all operations

\textbf{Responsibilities:}
\item Link operations to witnesses
\item Track provenance chains
\item Enable deterministic replay
\item Support contradiction detection

\textbf{Key Operations:}
\item }link\_provenance()\texttt{ - Connect operation to witness
\item }get\_provenance\_chain()\texttt{ - Retrieve full audit trail
\item }replay\_operation()\texttt{ - Deterministic replay from witnesses
\item }detect\_contradictions()\texttt{ - Find conflicting claims

\subsection*{κ-Gating: The Confidence Threshold System}

VIF enforces κ-gating (kappa-gating) to prevent low-confidence responses:

\textbf{Thresholds by Tier:}
\item \textbf{Tier S (Critical):} κ ≥ 0.95 (CMC, HHNI)
\item \textbf{Tier A (Core):} κ ≥ 0.90 (VIF, APOE, SEG)
\item \textbf{Tier B (Important):} κ ≥ 0.85
\item \textbf{Tier C (Supporting):} κ ≥ 0.80

\textbf{Abstention Rule:}
\item If κ < 0.70 → \textbf{ABSTAIN} (do not proceed)
\item Route to ARD research or human review
\item Document reason for abstention in CMC

\textbf{Gating Behavior:}
\item \textbf{Above threshold:} Proceed with operation
\item \textbf{Below threshold:} Block operation, require remediation
\item \textbf{Near threshold:} Warn but allow with extra validation

This ensures AI never proceeds with low confidence, preventing hallucinations and errors.

\subsection*{Failure Modes and Mitigations}
\item \textbf{Stale inputs:} schedule automated recompute (daily for Tier S, three times weekly for Tier A).
\item \textbf{Single-factor dominance:} report feature importance; re-balance weights when >50\% influence.
\item \textbf{Hidden drift:} maintain canary goals with expected VIF ranges and alarms when out-of-band.

\subsection*{Witness Envelopes \& Provenance}
VIF creates complete provenance through witness envelopes:

\item \textbf{Complete Traceability:} Every AI operation generates a witness envelope containing model ID, weights hash, exact prompts used, tools invoked, context snapshots, and uncertainty quantification. Enables complete audit trail and transparency.

\item \textbf{Provenance Components:} Witness envelopes include model version, exact prompts, context used, tools invoked, confidence levels, timestamps, and cryptographic hashes for verification.

\item \textbf{Storage \& Retrieval:} Witness envelopes stored in CMC as atoms with VIF tags. HHNI enables hierarchical navigation to find witnesses later. SEG links witnesses to evidence for contradiction detection.

\item \textbf{Audit Trail:} Complete provenance enables auditing of any AI decision. Reviewers can trace exactly how conclusions were reached, what context was used, and what confidence level was assigned.

\subsection*{κ-Gating \& Behavioral Abstention}
VIF enforces behavioral abstention when confidence is insufficient:

\item \textbf{κ-Gating Threshold:} When confidence (κ) < threshold (typically 0.70), AI must abstain from proceeding. This prevents hallucinations and ensures AI only acts when confident.

\item \textbf{Behavioral Enforcement:} κ-gating is behavioral, not just prompt-based. AI systems must actually abstain from operations, not just claim uncertainty. This prevents overconfidence and fabrication.

\item \textbf{Threshold Configuration:} Thresholds vary by tier: Tier S (0.95), Tier A (0.90), Tier B (0.85). Thresholds are configurable and reviewed weekly based on calibration data.

\item \textbf{Abstention Handling:} When AI abstains, it must provide clear explanation of why confidence is insufficient and what would be needed to proceed. This enables remediation and learning.

\subsection*{ECE Tracking \& Calibration}
VIF tracks calibration quality through Expected Calibration Error (ECE):

\item \textbf{Calibration Measurement:} ECE measures how well confidence predictions match actual accuracy. Target ECE ≤ 0.05 indicates well-calibrated confidence.

\item \textbf{Continuous Monitoring:} ECE tracked continuously across all operations. Calibration drift detected early and triggers recalibration procedures.

\item \textbf{Calibration Improvement:} When ECE exceeds threshold, VIF triggers calibration improvements: weight adjustments, threshold tuning, confidence recalibration.

\item \textbf{Calibration Reporting:} ECE metrics reported in dashboards and telemetry. Quarterly calibration reviews compare predictions with actual outcomes.

\subsection*{Confidence Bands \& Transparency}
VIF provides human-readable uncertainty through confidence bands:

\item \textbf{Band Classification:} Confidence bands (A/B/C) provide intuitive uncertainty levels. Band A (high confidence), Band B (medium confidence), Band C (low confidence).

\item \textbf{Band Assignment:} Bands assigned based on confidence scores and calibration data. Band A requires high confidence AND good calibration.

\item \textbf{Transparency:} Confidence bands visible in dashboards, telemetry, and user interfaces. Enables humans to understand AI uncertainty at a glance.

\item \textbf{Decision Support:} Confidence bands inform decision-making. Band A operations proceed automatically, Band B require review, Band C require human approval.

\subsection*{Deterministic Replay}
VIF enables bit-identical reproduction of AI operations:

\item \textbf{Replay Components:} Every operation stores replay seed, context snapshot, and exact prompts. Enables deterministic reproduction for debugging, auditing, and regression testing.

\item \textbf{Replay Execution:} Replay system uses stored seeds and snapshots to reproduce exact outputs. Enables debugging of AI decisions and validation of improvements.

\item \textbf{Replay Validation:} Replayed operations produce bit-identical outputs, proving determinism. Enables regression testing and quality assurance.

\item \textbf{Replay Storage:} Replay data stored in CMC with VIF tags. Enables historical replay and audit trail reconstruction.

\subsection*{VIF Troubleshooting Guide}

Common VIF issues and resolution procedures:

\subsubsection*{Issue 1: Witness Generation Failure}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item Witness creation fails or times out
\item Provenance links missing
\item Witness storage errors

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Check witness generation latency (should be <10ms)
2. Verify CMC storage availability
3. Check witness schema validation
4. Review witness generation logs

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{If CMC unavailable:} Failover to backup storage, retry witness creation
2. \textbf{If schema invalid:} Update witness schema, regenerate witnesses
3. \textbf{If timeout:} Increase timeout threshold, optimize witness generation
4. \textbf{If storage full:} Expand CMC storage, archive old witnesses

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Monitor CMC storage capacity
\item Validate witness schema before generation
\item Set appropriate timeout thresholds
\item Archive old witnesses regularly

\subsubsection*{Issue 2: κ-Gating False Positives}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item Operations blocked incorrectly (confidence above threshold)
\item False abstention routing
\item Threshold evaluation errors

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Check confidence scores vs thresholds
2. Verify threshold configuration
3. Review calibration data
4. Check gate enforcement logs

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{If threshold misconfigured:} Update threshold configuration, verify tier requirements
2. \textbf{If calibration drift:} Recalibrate confidence scores, update calibration data
3. \textbf{If gate bug:} Fix gate enforcement logic, verify gate behavior
4. \textbf{If false positive:} Adjust threshold sensitivity, review gate rules

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Validate threshold configuration regularly
\item Monitor calibration drift continuously
\item Test gate enforcement logic thoroughly
\item Review gate behavior in production

\subsubsection*{Issue 3: Calibration Drift}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item ECE exceeds threshold (>0.05)
\item Confidence scores don't match accuracy
\item Calibration degradation over time

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Calculate ECE for recent operations
2. Compare confidence vs actual accuracy
3. Identify calibration drift patterns
4. Review calibration update frequency

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{If ECE high:} Recalibrate confidence scores, update calibration model
2. \textbf{If drift detected:} Increase calibration update frequency, adjust calibration weights
3. \textbf{If model outdated:} Update calibration model, retrain on recent data
4. \textbf{If data quality poor:} Improve data quality, filter outliers

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Monitor ECE continuously
\item Update calibration regularly
\item Validate calibration data quality
\item Review calibration model performance

\subsubsection*{Issue 4: Provenance Chain Broken}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item Missing provenance links
\item Incomplete audit trails
\item Replay failures

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Verify provenance link creation
2. Check provenance storage integrity
3. Review provenance chain completeness
4. Test replay functionality

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{If links missing:} Regenerate provenance links, verify link creation
2. \textbf{If storage corrupted:} Restore from backup, verify storage integrity
3. \textbf{If chain incomplete:} Complete provenance chain, verify chain links
4. \textbf{If replay fails:} Fix replay logic, verify replay data

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Validate provenance links during creation
\item Monitor provenance storage integrity
\item Test replay functionality regularly
\item Archive provenance chains securely

\textbf{Key Insight:} VIF troubleshooting guide enables rapid diagnosis and resolution of common VIF issues, ensuring continuous confidence tracking and provenance integrity.
